description:
About the Role

Join an early-stage fintech team building a modern trading platform with an AI coaching experience. As a senior mobile engineer, you will help deliver reliable, real-time mobile experiences for traders.

What You'll Do

  • Build and maintain real-time mobile applications using React Native.

  • Ship and support releases on the App Store and Google Play.

  • Contribute to a dependable, user-friendly mobile trading experience.

What We're Looking For

  • At least 10 years of experience in mobile development.

  • Strong software engineering fundamentals and proficiency with React Native.

  • Experience building real-time mobile applications and maintaining published apps on the App Store and Google Play.

  • Trading platform experience is a plus, as is a background in fintech, financial markets, cryptocurrency, or stocks.

Compensation & Benefits

Base salary: $100,000 to $120,000 USD annually. Meaningful equity is offered. Visa sponsorship details are not provided.

Location

Fully remote. Primary location: Bucharest, Romania.
